mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE'))
mapper.select:
SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS internCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_status = 'FORMAL_TRAINEE' THEN u.user_id END) AS formalCount FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND
GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY internCount DESC, d.dept_id

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS learnTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.progress >= #{threshold} THEN s.id END) AS learnDone, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS learnPersons, ROUND(AVG(s.progress), 1) AS learnAvgProgress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.item_type = 'VIDEO' THEN s.study_duration ELSE 0 END), 0) AS videoSeconds FROM study_record s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE
GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.id) AS taskTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ta.status = 'DONE' THEN ta.id END) AS taskDone, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ta.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ta.id END) AS taskOverdue, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ta.status = 'NOT_STARTED' THEN ta.id END) AS taskNotStarted FROM task_assignment ta JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ta.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE
GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.position_name AS positionName, u.phonenumber AS phonenumber, u.user_status AS userStatus, CASE WHEN u.user_status = 'WAIT_AUDIT' THEN 'WAIT_AUDIT' WHEN u.user_status = 'PENDING_PROMOTE' THEN 'PENDING_PROMOTE' WHEN u.user_status = 'FORMAL_TRAINEE' THEN 'FORMAL_TRAINEE' ELSE 'PRE_TRAINEE' END AS stage, CASE WHEN u.user_status = 'WAIT_AUDIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS statusConflict, u.mentor_name AS mentorName, u.mentor_phone AS mentorPhone, CASE WHEN u.protocol_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS protocolSigned, DATEDIFF(NOW(), u.create_time) AS stayDays, u.expected_entry_date AS expectedEntryDate, u.create_time AS createTime, u.login_date AS loginDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_record s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id) AS learnTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_record s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.progress >= #{threshold}) AS learnDone, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.progress), 1) FROM study_record s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id) AS learnAvgProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_assignment ta WHERE ta.user_id = u.user_id) AS taskTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_assignment ta WHERE ta.user_id = u.user_id AND ta.status = 'OVERDUE') AS taskOverdue,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_record pr WHERE pr.user_id = u.user_id) AS practiceTimes, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(pr.correct_count) / NULLIF(SUM(pr.total_count), 0) * 100, 1) FROM practice_record pr WHERE pr.user_id = u.user_id) AS practiceAccuracy FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = u.position_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND
ORDER BY d.dept_id, u.user_id

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, dp.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN dept_position dp ON dp.dept_id = d.dept_id AND dp.status = 1 LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = dp.position_id WHERE d.dept_id = #{deptId} AND d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS cnt FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = u.position_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND d.dept_id = #{deptId} AND GROUP BY u.position_id, p.position_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, u.position_id

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.status AS status, c.is_required AS isRequired, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS learnedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS recordCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.progress >= #{threshold} THEN s.id END) AS doneCount, ROUND(AVG(s.progress), 1) AS avgProgress FROM course c JOIN dept_position dp ON dp.dept_id = #{deptId} AND dp.status = 1 AND dp.position_id = c.position_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.course_id, sr.progress FROM study_record sr JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = sr.user_id AND su.dept_id = #{deptId} AND su.del_flag = '0' AND su.status = '0' ) s ON s.course_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.course_name, c.status, c.is_required ORDER BY c.status, c.id

SELECT s.id AS recordId, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, s.chapter_id AS chapterId, s.item_id AS itemId, i.item_title AS itemTitle, s.item_type AS itemType, i.is_required AS isRequired, i.completion_threshold AS completionThreshold, s.status AS status, s.progress AS progress, s.study_duration AS studyDuration, s.read_confirm AS readConfirm, s.first_open_time AS firstOpenTime, s.finish_time AS finishTime, s.unfinished_reason AS unfinishedReason FROM study_record s LEFT JOIN study_item i ON i.id = s.item_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.course_id, s.chapter_id, i.sort_no, s.id

SELECT ta.id AS assignmentId, ta.task_id AS taskId, lt.task_name AS taskName, lt.theory_hours AS theoryHours, lt.practice_hours AS practiceHours, lt.deadline AS deadline, ta.status AS status, ta.create_time AS assignTime, ta.finish_time AS finishTime, sub.review_status AS reviewStatus, sub.submit_time AS submitTime, sub.file_name AS fileName, sub.file_url AS fileUrl, sub.version AS submitVersion, sub.review_comment AS reviewComment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submission allsub WHERE allsub.assignment_id = ta.id) AS submitCount FROM task_assignment ta LEFT JOIN learning_task lt ON lt.id = ta.task_id LEFT JOIN task_submission sub ON sub.id = ( SELECT ts.id FROM task_submission ts WHERE ts.assignment_id = ta.id ORDER BY ts.submit_time DESC, ts.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE ta.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY FIELD(ta.status, 'OVERDUE', 'NOT_STARTED', 'DONE'), ta.id
SELECT p.dept_id AS deptId, COUNT(1) AS practiceCount, ROUND(AVG(p.score), 2) AS practiceAvg FROM practice_record p WHERE p.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND p.dept_id = #{deptId} GROUP BY p.dept_id
SELECT e.dept_id AS deptId, COUNT(1) AS formalPublished FROM exam e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'FORMAL' AND e.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND e.dept_id = #{deptId} GROUP BY e.dept_id

SELECT t.point AS point, COUNT(1) AS items, SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct FROM ( SELECT q.knowledge_point AS point, pri.is_correct AS is_correct FROM practice_record_item pri INNER JOIN practice_record p ON p.id = pri.record_id INNER JOIN question q ON q.id = pri.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 WHERE p.dept_id = #{deptId} AND q.knowledge_point IS NOT NULL AND q.knowledge_point != '' UNION ALL SELECT q2.knowledge_point AS point, asi.is_correct AS is_correct FROM answer_sheet_item asi INNER JOIN answer_sheet s ON s.id = asi.answer_sheet_id INNER JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN question q2 ON q2.id = asi.question_id AND q2.deleted = 0 WHERE e.dept_id = #{deptId} AND asi.is_subjective = 0 AND q2.knowledge_point IS NOT NULL AND q2.knowledge_point != '' ) t GROUP BY t.point ORDER BY items DESC, t.point ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS date, p.correct_count AS correct, p.total_count AS total, p.score AS score, e.exam_name AS examName FROM practice_record p LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = p.exam_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS examId, e.exam_name AS examName, e.exam_type AS examType, e.exam_mode AS examMode, e.pass_line AS passLine, s.id AS sheetId, s.status AS sheetStatus, s.ai_score AS aiScore, s.manual_score AS manualScore, s.final_score AS finalScore, s.pass_flag AS passFlag, DATE_FORMAT(s.submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS submitTime FROM answer_sheet s INNER JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'FORMAL' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.submit_time ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT t.point AS point, COUNT(1) AS items, SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct FROM ( SELECT q.knowledge_point AS point, pri.is_correct AS is_correct FROM practice_record_item pri INNER JOIN practice_record p ON p.id = pri.record_id INNER JOIN question q ON q.id = pri.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND q.knowledge_point IS NOT NULL AND q.knowledge_point != '' UNION ALL SELECT q2.knowledge_point AS point, asi.is_correct AS is_correct FROM answer_sheet_item asi INNER JOIN answer_sheet s ON s.id = asi.answer_sheet_id INNER JOIN question q2 ON q2.id = asi.question_id AND q2.deleted = 0 WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND asi.is_subjective = 0 AND q2.knowledge_point IS NOT NULL AND q2.knowledge_point != '' ) t GROUP BY t.point ORDER BY items DESC, t.point ASC

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, MAX(CASE WHEN s.pass_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, COUNT(1) AS sheetCount, ROUND(MAX(s.final_score), 1) AS bestScore FROM answer_sheet s INNER JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'FORMAL' WHERE s.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.dept_id = #{deptId} GROUP BY s.user_id
